candidates.decision_relevance: Would reveal whether weakness, rebound, and renewed weakness occurred in sequence, and how large each move was, rather than relying on weekly endpoints and qualitative path descriptions.
candidates.evidence_reference: W45 review lacks underlying hourly observations and rebound magnitude; several daily reviews also flag incomplete or shortened hourly windows.
candidates.metric_name: BTC and ETH hourly price paths with observation timestamps
candidates.missing_history_problem: Without consistently timestamped hourly BTC and ETH prices, path ordering and rebound persistence cannot be compared across weeks or aligned with other observations.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether participation changes persisted or merely reflected different point-in-time samples, helping test the repeated broad-participation hypotheses without treating proxy snapshots as independent evidence.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily reviews report proxy breadth snapshots with changing membership hashes; weekly reviews repeatedly lack time-ordered breadth measurements.
candidates.metric_name: Daily breadth counts and constituent membership for a consistently defined tracked universe
candidates.missing_history_problem: Changing memberships and isolated snapshots prevent reliable comparisons of breadth persistence and its timing relative to price moves.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would permit comparison of settled BTC and ETH flows over the same periods as weekly price paths, rather than extrapolating from one session or carrying prior-week flows forward.
candidates.evidence_reference: W44 review has no settled-flow rows; other weekly reviews cite only earlier weeks or single-session ETF observations.
candidates.metric_name: Daily settled BTC and ETH ETF flow totals with settlement dates
candidates.missing_history_problem: Sparse and non-aligned settled-flow observations leave persistence, divergence, and temporal relation to price weakness unresolved.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would allow retrospective auditing of whether a forecast or warning used only information available at its issuance and whether its stated horizon and target can be matched to matured outcomes.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly and daily reviews repeatedly report missing candidate specifications, issue times, point-in-time evidence cutoffs, and candidate-linked outcome rows.
candidates.metric_name: Frozen forecast specifications, issuance timestamps, evidence cutoffs, and linked matured outcomes
candidates.missing_history_problem: Without a traceable event record, hindsight leakage, range containment, and candidate-specific outcome assessment cannot be reconstructed.
